CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically randomizes all dropdowns when musical transitions are detected
CONTROLS.NAME: auto_cycle

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Warps media content using the same warp as the background effect
CONTROLS.NAME: media_warp

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Texture distortion effects: Waving (fluid noise motion), Still (no distortion), Still 2 (no distortion), Woozy (stretching and drippy distortion)
CONTROLS.NAME: warp_type

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls camera movement: Moves In (zoom toward center), Rotate Only (static), Moves Out (zoom away from center)
CONTROLS.NAME: wind_movement

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Selects background texture that feeds the aurora. Choose your own media to replace the texture.
CONTROLS.NAME: image_select

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds extra coloration if you want more saturated colors.
CONTROLS.NAME: extra_color_tint

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls thickness of the image scanning lines that feed the aurora
CONTROLS.NAME: scanline_thinness

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Static phase offset for the scanning pattern
CONTROLS.NAME: static_scan

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse of scan through the media
CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_forward

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast the scanner will move when audio is present
CONTROLS.NAME: scanner_audio_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Base constant speed for the scanner animation, independent of audio input
CONTROLS.NAME: scanner_const_rate
